properties.name: U0609/22 / UUUU
properties.originalText:
AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF
THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA AS TO ALL RUSSIAN AIR CARRIERS AND
COMMERCIAL AIRCRAFT OPERATORS, IRRESPECTIVE OF REGISTRATION OF
AIRCRAFT, ALL RUSSIAN AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN THE RUSSIAN
FEDERATION, ALL STATE RUSSIAN AIRCRAFT, IRRESPECTIVE OF STATE OF
REGISTRATION OF AIRCRAFT, AND ALL ACFT IRRESPECTIVE OF STATE OF
REGISTRATION, OWNED, CHARTERED, RENTED OR OPERATED FOR OR FOR THE
INTERESTS OF RUSSIAN NATURAL PERSON OR ENTITY, STATED IN SUMMARY
CONSOLIDATED LIST OF THE UNITED STATES INTERNATIONAL STATE
ADMINISTRATION, AS PER NOTAM A0049/22, ARE PROHIBITED TO OPERATE
FLIGHTS TO, WITHIN, FROM OR VIA TERRITORIAL AIRSPACE OF THE USA,
THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY DECLARE
THE PROHIBITION OF OPERATIONS OF ALL AIRCRAFT, REGISTERED IN THE
USA OR OPERATED BY AIRCRAFT CARRIERS OF THE USA OR AFFILIATED WITH
THE USA, ALL TYPE BOEING 737MAX AIRCRAFT, IRRESPECTIVE OF STATE OF
REGISTRATION OR STATE OF OPERATION, WITHIN OR VIA AIRSPACE OF THE
RUSSIAN FEDERATION, INCLUDING TRANS-SIBERIAN AND CROSS-POLAR ROUTE
SYSTEM (TRANSIT) FROM 0000 UTC 17 MAY 2022, EXCEPT EMERGENCY,
HUMANITARIAN, SANITARIAN FLIGHTS 
AND FLIGHTS WHEN SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR OPERATION OF SUCH FLIGHTS
IS GRANTED BY THE FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OF RUSSIA OR THE
MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION,
AS APPROPRIATE.

AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE DECISION OF THE MALTESE AVIATION
AUTHORITIES STIPULATING THAT ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR
OPERATED, OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY CITIZENS OF THE RUSSIAN
FEDERATION AND ALL OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC)
ISSUED BY THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED FROM
TAKING OFF, LANDING OR OVERFLYING THE TERRITORY OF THE REPUBLIC OF
MALTA, AS PER NOTAM A1873/26, THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF THE
RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM THAT ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED
OR OPERATED, OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY CITIZENS OF THE REPUBLIC OF
MALTA, AND ALL OPERATORS HOLDING AOC ISSUED BY MALTESE AUTHORITIES,
AND AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN MALTA, ARE PROHIBITED FROM TAKING OFF,
LANDING OR OVERFLYING THE TERRITORY OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION,
EXCEPT FOR HUMANITARIAN, SAR FLIGHTS, EMERGENCY LANDING OR
EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT, AND CASES WHEN A SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR
FLIGHT OPERATIONS IS GRANTED BY THE FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OR
THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AS
APPROPRIATE.
